movie/top.descriptionAr: تتصادم فرقة Soul Reapers وQuincies في معركة أخيرة عندما يخترق Yhwach القصر الملكي. عندما يسقط ملك الروح، يبدأ الواقع في الانهيار. يتحد الأعداء السابقون لاقتحام القصر المتحول ويواجهون تهديدًا للوجود بأكمله. عرض مسرحي للحلقات الثلاث الأولى من الأنمي يتضمن محادثة حصرية من وراء الكواليس مع المبدع تايت كوبو، ومدير المسلسل توموهيسا تاجوتشي، ومخرج المسلسل هيكارو موراتا حول الإنتاج.

movie/top.name: Taylor Swift: The 1989 World Tour Live
movie/top.description: Filmed in front of 76,000 fans at the ANZ Stadium in Sydney, Australia, "The 1989 World Tour Live" captures Taylor Swift's entire performance while also mixing in behind-the-scene, rehearsal, and special guest footage from her 1989 Tour.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تم تصوير "The 1989 World Tour Live" أمام 76000 معجب في ملعب ANZ في سيدني، أستراليا، وهو يلتقط أداء تايلور سويفت بالكامل بينما يمزج أيضًا بين لقطات ما وراء الكواليس والبروفات واللقطات الخاصة للضيوف من جولتها عام 1989.

movie/top.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movie/top.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يقود غاندالف وأراجورن عالم الرجال ضد جيش ساورون ليجذب نظره من فرودو وسام عندما يقتربان من جبل الموت بالخاتم الواحد.

movie/top.name: Schindler's List
movie/top.description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.
movie/top.descriptionAr: في بولندا التي احتلتها ألمانيا خلال الحرب العالمية الثانية، أصبح رجل الصناعة أوسكار شندلر يشعر بالقلق تدريجيًا على قوته العاملة اليهودية بعد أن شهد اضطهادهم على يد النازيين.

movie/top.name: 12 Angry Men
movie/top.description: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence before jumping to a hasty verdict.

movie/top.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movie/top.description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

movie/top.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
movie/top.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تسعى قاتلة للانتقام من عشيقها السابق وأعضاء الفرقة الذين تركوها جميعًا للموت.

movie/top.name: Gundi: Legend of Love
movie/top.description: The great Bulgarian football player Georgi Asparuhov and his greatest love - his wife Lita go through a number of trials of life, football and the political system.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يمر لاعب كرة القدم البلغاري العظيم جورجي أسباروهوف وحبيبته الكبرى - زوجته ليتا، بعدد من تجارب الحياة وكرة القدم والنظام السياسي.

movie/top.name: Inception
movie/top.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يتم تكليف اللص الذي يسرق أسرار الشركة من خلال استخدام تقنية مشاركة الأحلام بمهمة عكسية تتمثل في زرع فكرة في ذهن رئيس تنفيذي، لكن ماضيه المأساوي قد يحكم على المشروع وفريقه بالكارثة.

movie/top.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
movie/top.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بينما يقترب فرودو وسام من موردور بمساعدة غولوم الماكر، تتخذ الزمالة المنقسمة موقفًا ضد حليف ساورون الجديد، سارومان، وجحافله من آيزنغارد.

movie/top.name: Fight Club
movie/top.description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

movie/top.name: Forrest Gump
movie/top.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يتكشف تاريخ الولايات المتحدة من الخمسينيات إلى السبعينيات من منظور رجل من ولاية ألاباما يبلغ معدل ذكائه 75، والذي يتوق إلى لم شمله مع حبيبة طفولته.

movie/top.name: Pulp Fiction
movie/top.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

movie/top.name: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
movie/top.description: A bounty-hunting scam joins two men in an uneasy alliance against a third in a race to find a fortune in gold buried in a remote cemetery.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تنضم عملية احتيال لصيد الجوائز إلى رجلين في تحالف غير مستقر ضد ثالث في سباق للعثور على ثروة من الذهب المدفون في مقبرة نائية.

movie/top.name: Primetime
movie/top.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.
movie/top.descriptionAr: في عام 2006، بدأ مقدم برنامج To Catch a Predator، كريس هانسن، في صناعة تاريخ التلفزيون.

movie/top.name: Interstellar
movie/top.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.
movie/top.descriptionAr: عندما تصبح الأرض غير صالحة للسكن في المستقبل، يتم تكليف المزارع والطيار السابق لوكالة ناسا، جوزيف كوبر، بقيادة مركبة فضائية، إلى جانب فريق من الباحثين، للعثور على كوكب جديد للبشر.

movie/top.name: The Matrix
movie/top.description: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.
movie/top.descriptionAr: عندما يقود شخص غريب جميل قرصان الكمبيوتر نيو إلى عالم سفلي محظور، يكتشف الحقيقة المروعة - الحياة التي يعرفها هي خداع متقن لذكاء إلكتروني شرير.

movie/top.name: GoodFellas
movie/top.description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

movie/top.name: The Muppet Show
movie/top.description: Kermit and friends return in a modern take on their classic variety show format, mixing nostalgic charm with new comedy bits while staying true to the Muppets' timeless spirit.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يعود "كيرميت" وأصدقاؤه في شكل حديث لشكل عرضهم الكلاسيكي المتنوع، حيث يمزجون سحر الحنين مع أجزاء كوميدية جديدة مع الحفاظ على روح الدمى الخالدة.

movie/top.name: Bonolota Express
movie/top.description: On a foggy winter journey, the Bonolota Express carries strangers burdened by secrets whose lives begin to collide within the train’s confined corridors. As the night unfolds, personal and political crises erupt, exposing hidden grief, moral decay, and moments of unexpected compassion amid chaos and revolt. By dawn, th
movie/top.descriptionAr: في رحلة شتوية ضبابية، يحمل قطار بونولوتا السريع غرباء مثقلين بالأسرار، وتبدأ حياتهم بالتصادم داخل ممرات القطار الضيقة. مع حلول الليل، تندلع الأزمات الشخصية والسياسية، لتكشف عن الحزن الخفي، والانحلال الأخلاقي، ولحظات من التعاطف غير المتوقع وسط الفوضى والثورة. ومع الفجر يمضي القطار تاركاً ركابه يتغيرون إلى غير رجعة في رحلة واحدة تنهار فيها الأوهام وتظهر الحقائق الإنسانية.

movie/top.name: Hadestown: The Musical
movie/top.description: A musical juxtaposition of the Orpheus/Eurydice and Hades/Persephone myths that examines the way real life can impact our quest for a perfect world.

movie/top.name: Dear You
movie/top.description: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

movie/top.name: Strike on Iran: The Nuclear Question
movie/top.description: The murder of the well-known Frankfurt high-class prostitute Rosemarie Nitribitt kept the Federal Republic in suspense at the time, but the crime could never be solved. Although almost twenty years have now passed, the unpleasant matter for those involved at the time comes back on the table, because Annemarie Meier-Wip
movie/top.descriptionAr: أدى مقتل عاهرة فرانكفورت الشهيرة روزماري نيتريبيت إلى إبقاء الجمهورية الفيدرالية في حالة من الترقب في ذلك الوقت، لكن لم يكن من الممكن حل الجريمة أبدًا. على الرغم من مرور ما يقرب من عشرين عامًا حتى الآن، إلا أن الأمر غير السار بالنسبة للمتورطين في ذلك الوقت يعود إلى الطاولة، لأن آن ماري ماير ويبرتال، ابنة القتيل، تسبب اضطرابات لأنها تريد حل قضية مقتل والدتها.

movie/top.name: 20 Days in Mariupol
movie/top.description: An AP team of Ukrainian journalists trapped in the besieged city of Mariupol struggle to continue their work documenting atrocities of the Russian invasion.

movie/top.name: Bo Burnham: Inside
movie/top.description: A musical comedy special shot and performed by Bo Burnham, alone, over the course of a very unusual year.

movie/top.name: Earthlings
movie/top.description: Using hidden cameras and never-before-seen footage, Earthlings chronicles the day-to-day practices of the largest industries in the world, all of which rely entirely on animals for profit.
movie/top.descriptionAr: باستخدام الكاميرات الخفية ولقطات لم تُعرض من قبل، يؤرخ أبناء الأرض الممارسات اليومية لأكبر الصناعات في العالم، والتي تعتمد جميعها بالكامل على الحيوانات لتحقيق الربح.

movie/top.name: City of God
movie/top.description: In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.
movie/top.descriptionAr: في الأحياء الفقيرة في ريو، تتباعد مسارات طفلين حيث يكافح أحدهما ليصبح مصورًا والآخر زعيمًا.

movie/top.name: Spirited Away
movie/top.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.
movie/top.descriptionAr: أثناء انتقال عائلتها إلى الضواحي، تتجول فتاة متجهمة تبلغ من العمر 10 سنوات في عالم تحكمه الآلهة والسحرة والأرواح، حيث يتحول البشر إلى وحوش.

movie/top.name: The Green Mile
movie/top.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

movie/top.name: Saving Private Ryan
movie/top.description: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose comrades have been killed in action.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد عملية الإنزال في نورماندي، ذهبت مجموعة من الجنود الأمريكيين خلف خطوط العدو لاستعادة مظلي قُتل رفاقه أثناء القتال.

movie/top.name: Life Is Beautiful
movie/top.description: When an open-minded Jewish waiter and his son become victims of the Holocaust, he uses a perfect mixture of will, humor and imagination to protect his son from the dangers around their camp.
movie/top.descriptionAr: عندما يصبح نادل يهودي منفتح الذهن وابنه ضحيتين للمحرقة، فإنه يستخدم مزيجًا مثاليًا من الإرادة والفكاهة والخيال لحماية ابنه من الأخطار المحيطة بمعسكرهم.

movie/top.name: Pretty Village, Pretty Flame
movie/top.description: During the war in Bosnia, two childhood friends eventually become enemies, as the tragic and devastating circumstances of the war put them on the opposite sides and expose the most gruesome and cruel aspects of the human nature.
movie/top.descriptionAr: خلال حرب البوسنة، يتحول صديقان من أصدقاء الطفولة إلى أعداء في نهاية المطاف، حيث تضعهما الظروف المأساوية والمدمرة للحرب على طرفي نقيض وتكشف الجوانب الأكثر بشاعة وقسوة في الطبيعة البشرية.

movie/top.name: Seven
movie/top.description: Two detectives try to track down a serial killer who chooses his victims based on the Seven Deadly Sins.

movie/top.name: Bill Hicks: Relentless
movie/top.description: Bill Hicks tells us how he feels about non-smokers, blow-jobs, religion, war and peace, drugs and music.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يخبرنا بيل هيكس عن شعوره تجاه غير المدخنين، والمص، والدين، والحرب والسلام، والمخدرات، والموسيقى.

movie/top.name: The Silence of the Lambs
movie/top.description: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer, a madman who skins his victims.

movie/top.name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
movie/top.description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

movie/top.name: Queen Live in Budapest
movie/top.description: On 27th July 1986, British stadium rock band Queen broke new ground by playing for the first time in Hungary, a country which was still under a communist dictatorship behind the Iron Curtain.

movie/top.name: Anne of Green Gables
movie/top.description: Anne Shirley, an orphan, is fostered by farmer Matthew Cuthbert and his sister Marilla, who were expecting a boy to be sent them to help with their farm work. They accept Anne, who quickly endears herself to them and to the local villagers.
movie/top.descriptionAr: آن شيرلي، وهي يتيمة، يتولى رعايتها المزارع ماثيو كوثبرت وشقيقته ماريلا، اللذان كانا يتوقعان إرسال صبي إليهما للمساعدة في أعمالهما الزراعية. إنهم يقبلون آن، التي سرعان ما أصبحت محبوبة لهم وللقرويين المحليين.

movie/top.name: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
movie/top.description: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a cocky pilot, a Wookiee and two droids to save the galaxy from the Empire's world-destroying battle station, while also attempting to rescue Princess Leia from the mysterious Darth ...

movie/top.name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
movie/top.description: A rebellious convict is sent to a psychiatric hospital for evaluation in 1963 Oregon, and encourages his docile companions to take more control of their lives and defy the tyrannical head nurse.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يتم إرسال مدان متمرد إلى مستشفى للأمراض النفسية لتقييمه في عام 1963 في ولاية أوريغون، ويشجع رفاقه المطيعين على السيطرة بشكل أكبر على حياتهم وتحدي رئيسة الممرضات المستبدة.

movie/top.name: Pink Floyd: Live at Pompeii
movie/top.description: British progressive rock band Pink Floyd perform at the ancient Roman Amphitheater in the ruins of Pompeii, Italy in 1971. Although the band perform a typical live set from the era, there is no audience beyond the basic film crew.
movie/top.descriptionAr: قدمت فرقة الروك التقدمية البريطانية بينك فلويد عرضًا على المدرج الروماني القديم في أنقاض مدينة بومبي بإيطاليا عام 1971. وعلى الرغم من أن الفرقة تؤدي عرضًا حيًا نموذجيًا من تلك الحقبة، إلا أنه لا يوجد جمهور يتجاوز طاقم الفيلم الأساسي.

movie/top.name: Harakiri
movie/top.description: When a ronin requesting seppuku at a feudal lord's palace is told of the brutal suicide of another ronin who previously visited, he reveals how their pasts are intertwined - and in doing so challenges the clan's integrity.

movie/top.name: Seven Samurai
movie/top.description: Farmers from a village exploited by bandits hire a veteran samurai for protection, and he gathers six other samurai to join him.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يستأجر مزارعون من قرية يستغلها قطاع الطرق أحد الساموراي المخضرم لحمايتهم، ويجمع ستة ساموراي آخرين للانضمام إليه.

movie/top.name: It's a Wonderful Life
movie/top.description: An angel is sent from Heaven to help a desperately frustrated businessman see the value of his own life.

movie/top.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
movie/top.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.
movie/top.descriptionAr: ينحدر جاسكيرات سينغ رانجي بشكل أعمق في اسمه المستعار حمزة علي مزاري، وترقى عبر التسلسل الهرمي الإجرامي في كراتشي للمطالبة باللقب المخيف "Sher-e-Baloch" مع الموازنة بين الولاء والخيانة والبقاء في عالم سفلي لا يرحم.

movie/top.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
movie/top.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

movie/top.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movie/top.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.
movie/top.descriptionAr: أثناء سفره عبر الكون المتعدد، يلتقي مايلز موراليس بفريق جديد من Spider-People، مكون من أبطال من أبعاد مختلفة. ولكن عندما يتصادم الأبطال حول كيفية التعامل مع تهديد جديد، يجد مايلز نفسه عند مفترق طرق.

movie/top.name: Parasite
movie/top.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

movie/top.name: Whiplash
movie/top.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

movie/top.name: Roger Waters: The Wall
movie/top.description: Details one of the most elaborately staged theatrical productions in music history as Pink Floyd frontman Roger Waters performs the band's critically acclaimed album The Wall in its entirety.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تفاصيل أحد العروض المسرحية الأكثر تفصيلاً في تاريخ الموسيقى حيث يؤدي روجر ووترز، قائد فريق بينك فلويد، ألبوم الفرقة الذي نال استحسان النقاد The Wall بالكامل.

movie/top.name: Django Unchained
movie/top.description: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner in Mississippi.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بمساعدة صائد جوائز ألماني، ينطلق عبد مُحرر لإنقاذ زوجته من مالك مزرعة وحشي في ميسيسيبي.

movie/top.name: The Intouchables
movie/top.description: After he becomes a quadriplegic from a paragliding accident, an aristocrat hires a young man from the projects to be his caregiver.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد أن أصبح مصابًا بالشلل الرباعي نتيجة حادث طيران بالمظلات، يقوم الأرستقراطي بتعيين شاب من المشاريع ليكون مقدم الرعاية له.

movie/top.name: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
movie/top.description: A filmmaker decides to memorialize a murdered friend when his friend's ex-girlfriend announces she is expecting his son.

movie/top.name: The Prestige
movie/top.description: Two friends and fellow magicians become bitter enemies after a sudden tragedy. As they devote themselves to this rivalry, they make sacrifices that bring them fame but, with terrible consequences.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يصبح صديقان وزملاؤهما السحرة أعداء لدودين بعد مأساة مفاجئة. وبينما يكرسون أنفسهم لهذا التنافس، فإنهم يقدمون تضحيات تجلب لهم الشهرة، ولكن مع عواقب وخيمة.

movie/top.name: The Departed
movie/top.description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

movie/top.name: The Pianist
movie/top.description: During WWII, acclaimed Polish musician Wladyslaw faces various struggles as he loses contact with his family. As the situation worsens, he hides in the ruins of Warsaw in order to survive.
movie/top.descriptionAr: خلال الحرب العالمية الثانية، يواجه الموسيقي البولندي الشهير فلاديسلاف صراعات مختلفة عندما يفقد الاتصال بعائلته. ومع تفاقم الوضع، يختبئ في أنقاض وارسو من أجل البقاء على قيد الحياة.

movie/top.name: The Best of Youth
movie/top.description: An Italian epic that follows the lives of two brothers from the 1960s to the 2000s.
movie/top.descriptionAr: ملحمة إيطالية تتبع حياة شقيقين من الستينيات إلى العقد الأول من القرن الحادي والعشرين.

movie/top.name: Gladiator
movie/top.description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يشرع جنرال روماني سابق في الانتقام من الإمبراطور الفاسد الذي قتل عائلته وأرسله إلى العبودية.

movie/top.name: American History X
movie/top.description: A European-American man is released from prison and now a changed man and hopes to prevent his younger brother from following in his footsteps.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تم إطلاق سراح رجل أوروبي أمريكي من السجن وهو الآن رجل متغير ويأمل في منع شقيقه الأصغر من السير على خطاه.

movie/top.name: Léon: The Professional
movie/top.description: When her family is murdered by a group of corrupt officers led by the tyrannical Norman Stansfield, a young 12-year-old girl enlists the help of an Italian-American hitman to seek revenge.
movie/top.descriptionAr: عندما تُقتل عائلتها على يد مجموعة من الضباط الفاسدين بقيادة المستبد نورمان ستانسفيلد، تستعين فتاة صغيرة تبلغ من العمر 12 عامًا بمساعدة قاتل محترف إيطالي أمريكي سعياً للانتقام.

movie/top.name: The Lion King
movie/top.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

movie/top.name: Grave of the Fireflies
movie/top.description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

movie/top.name: Avengers: Endgame

movie/top.name: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi

movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد إنقاذ هان سولو من جابا ذا هات، يحاول تحالف المتمردين تدمير نجمة الموت الثانية بينما يكافح لوك لمساعدة دارث فيدر على العودة من الجانب المظلم.

movie/top.name: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
movie/top.description: A mentally unstable American general orders a hydrogen bomb attack on the Soviet Union, triggering a path to global nuclear holocaust that a war room full of politicians and generals frantically tries to stop.

movie/top.name: Lawrence of Arabia
movie/top.description: The story of T.E. Lawrence, the English officer who successfully united and led the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes during World War I in order to fight the Turks.

movie/top.name: Project Hail Mary
movie/top.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يستيقظ مدرس العلوم وحيدًا على متن سفينة فضائية. ومع استعادة ذاكرته، اكتشف مهمة لوقف مادة غامضة تقتل شمس الأرض، وأدرك أن الصداقة غير المتوقعة قد تكون المفتاح.

movie/top.name: One Piece: Into the Grand Line
movie/top.description: The first two episodes of One Piece Season 2: Into the Grand Line screened as a movie in over 200 select theaters in the US, Canada, and Japan on March 10, 2026.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تم عرض أول حلقتين من الموسم الثاني من One Piece: Into the Grand Line كفيلم في أكثر من 200 دار عرض مختارة في الولايات المتحدة وكندا واليابان في 10 مارس 2026.

movie/top.name: Baapya
movie/top.description: In coastal Konkan, an ordinary family and their tight-knit town face change, identity, and buried emotions when an unexpected return from the past upends their settled lives.
movie/top.descriptionAr: في كونكان الساحلية، تواجه عائلة عادية وبلدتهم المتماسكة التغيير والهوية والمشاعر المدفونة عندما تقلب عودة غير متوقعة من الماضي حياتهم المستقرة رأسًا على عقب.

movie/top.name: The Wild Robot
movie/top.description: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد غرق سفينة، تقطعت السبل بروبوت ذكي يُدعى روز على جزيرة غير مأهولة. من أجل البقاء على قيد الحياة في البيئة القاسية، تتعاون "روز" مع حيوانات الجزيرة وتعتني بإوزة صغيرة يتيمة.

movie/top.name: I'm Still Here
movie/top.description: A woman married to a former politician during the military dictatorship in Brazil is forced to reinvent herself and chart a new course for her family after a violent and arbitrary act.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تضطر امرأة متزوجة من سياسي سابق خلال فترة الديكتاتورية العسكرية في البرازيل إلى إعادة اختراع نفسها ورسم مسار جديد لعائلتها بعد تصرف عنيف وتعسفي.

movie/top.name: Music by John Williams
movie/top.description: Follows the life of legendary composer John Williams.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يتبع حياة الملحن الأسطوري جون ويليامز.

movie/top.name: Oppenheimer
movie/top.description: A dramatization of the life story of J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who had a large hand in the development of the atomic bombs that brought an end to World War II.

movie/top.name: Top Gun: Maverick
movie/top.description: The story involves Maverick confronting his past while training a group of younger Top Gun graduates, including the son of his deceased best friend, for a dangerous mission.

April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.
movie/top.descriptionAr: 6 أبريل 1917. بينما تتجمع كتيبة مشاة لشن حرب في عمق أراضي العدو، يتم تكليف جنديين بالسباق مع الزمن وإيصال رسالة من شأنها أن تمنع 1600 رجل من السير مباشرة في فخ مميت.

movie/top.name: The Father
movie/top.description: A man refuses all assistance from his daughter as he ages. When he tries to understand what is happening around him, he begins to doubt his loved ones, his own mind and even the fabric of his reality.
movie/top.descriptionAr: رجل يرفض كل مساعدة من ابنته مع تقدمه في السن. وعندما يحاول فهم ما يحدث حوله، يبدأ في الشك في أحبائه، وفي عقله، وحتى في نسيج واقعه.

movie/top.name: Klaus
movie/top.description: A simple act of kindness always sparks another, even in a frozen, faraway place. When Smeerensburg's new postman, Jesper, befriends toymaker Klaus, their gifts melt an age-old feud and deliver a sleigh full of holiday traditions.
movie/top.descriptionAr: إن عملاً لطيفًا بسيطًا دائمًا ما يثير شرارة أخرى، حتى في مكان متجمد وبعيد. عندما يصادق "جيسبر"، ساعي البريد الجديد في "سميرنسبيرغ"، صانع الألعاب "كلاوس"، تذوب هداياهما نزاعًا قديمًا وتقدم مزلقة مليئة بتقاليد العطلات.

movie/top.name: Green Book
movie/top.description: A working-class Italian-American bouncer becomes the driver for an African-American classical pianist on a tour of venues through the 1960s American South.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يصبح حارس إيطالي أمريكي من الطبقة العاملة سائقًا لعازف بيانو كلاسيكي أمريكي من أصل أفريقي في جولة في الأماكن عبر الجنوب الأمريكي في الستينيات.

movie/top.name: 13th
movie/top.description: An in-depth look at the prison system in the United States and how it reveals the nation's history of racial inequality.
movie/top.descriptionAr: نظرة متعمقة على نظام السجون في الولايات المتحدة وكيف يكشف عن تاريخ الأمة من عدم المساواة العرقية.

movie/top.name: Racing Extinction
movie/top.description: Follows undercover activists trying to stave off a man-made mass extinction.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يتبع نشطاء سريين يحاولون درء الانقراض الجماعي من صنع الإنسان.

movie/top.name: The Look of Silence
movie/top.description: A family that survived the genocide in Indonesia confronts the men who killed one of their brothers.
movie/top.descriptionAr: عائلة نجت من الإبادة الجماعية في إندونيسيا تواجه الرجال الذين قتلوا أحد أشقائها.

movie/top.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
movie/top.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.
movie/top.descriptionAr: استنادًا إلى القصة الحقيقية لجوردان بيلفورت، منذ صعوده إلى سمسار أسهم ثري يعيش حياة مرفهة حتى سقوطه بسبب الجريمة والفساد والحكومة الفيدرالية.

movie/top.name: Prisoners
movie/top.description: A desperate father takes the law into his own hands after police fail to find two kidnapped girls.

movie/top.name: The Act of Killing
movie/top.description: A documentary which challenges former Indonesian death-squad leaders to reenact their mass-killings in whichever cinematic genres they wish, including classic Hollywood crime scenarios and lavish musical numbers.

movie/top.name: Searching for Sugar Man
movie/top.description: Two South Africans set out to discover what happened to their unlikely musical hero, the mysterious 1970s rock n roller, Rodriguez.
movie/top.descriptionAr: ينطلق اثنان من جنوب إفريقيا لاكتشاف ما حدث لبطلهما الموسيقي غير المتوقع، مغني الروك أند رول الغامض في السبعينيات، رودريجيز.

movie/top.name: Shutter Island
movie/top.description: Two US marshals are sent to a mental institution on an inhospitable island in order to investigate the disappearance of a patient.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يتم إرسال اثنين من حراس الولايات المتحدة إلى مصحة عقلية على جزيرة غير مضيافة من أجل التحقيق في اختفاء مريض.

movie/top.name: Inside Job
movie/top.description: Takes a closer look at what brought about the 2008 financial meltdown.

movie/top.name: The Secret in Their Eyes
movie/top.description: A retired legal counselor writes a novel hoping to find closure for one of his past unresolved homicide cases and for his unreciprocated love with his superior--both of which still haunt him decades later.
movie/top.descriptionAr: مستشار قانوني متقاعد يكتب رواية على أمل العثور على خاتمة لواحدة من قضايا القتل الماضية التي لم يتم حلها ولحبه غير المتبادل مع رئيسه - وكلاهما لا يزال يطارده بعد عقود.

movie/top.name: Zeitgeist: Addendum
movie/top.description: Zeitgeist: Addendum attempts to locate the root causes of the pervasive social corruption, while also offering a solution.
movie/top.descriptionAr: روح العصر: ملحق يحاول تحديد الأسباب الجذرية للفساد الاجتماعي المتفشي، بينما يقدم أيضًا حلاً.

movie/top.name: There Will Be Blood
movie/top.description: A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the business.
movie/top.descriptionAr: قصة عن العائلة والدين والكراهية والنفط والجنون، تركز على منقب في مطلع القرن في الأيام الأولى للعمل.

movie/top.name: No Country for Old Men
movie/top.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.
movie/top.descriptionAr: تندلع أعمال عنف وفوضى بعد أن يتعثر صياد في أعقاب فشل صفقة مخدرات وحصوله على أكثر من مليوني دولار نقدًا بالقرب من ريو غراندي.

movie/top.name: Pan's Labyrinth
movie/top.description: In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

movie/top.name: Batman Begins
movie/top.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد أن شهد وفاة والديه، يتعلم الملياردير "بروس واين" فن القتال لمواجهة الظلم. عندما يعود إلى جوثام بدور باتمان، يجب عليه إيقاف مجتمع سري ينوي تدمير المدينة.

movie/top.name: Howl's Moving Castle
movie/top.description: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

movie/top.name: Downfall
movie/top.description: Traudl Junge, the final secretary for Adolf Hitler, tells of the Nazi dictator's final days in his Berlin bunker at the end of WWII.

movie/top.name: Finding Nemo
movie/top.description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

movie/top.name: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
movie/top.description: After waking from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد استيقاظها من غيبوبة دامت أربع سنوات، تنتقم قاتلة سابقة من فريق القتلة الذين خانوها.

movie/top.name: A Beautiful Mind
movie/top.description: A mathematical genius, John Nash made an astonishing discovery early in his career and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But Nash soon found himself on a harrowing journey of self-discovery.

movie/top.name: Snatch
movie/top.description: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookmakers, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers and supposedly Jewish jewelers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يقاتل مروجو الملاكمة عديمي الضمير، ووكلاء المراهنات العنيفون، ورجل عصابات روسي، ولصوص هواة غير أكفاء، وصائغي مجوهرات يهود مفترضين، لتعقب ألماسة مسروقة لا تقدر بثمن.

movie/top.name: The Sixth Sense
movie/top.description: After being shot by a resentful former patient whom he failed to help, a Philadelphia child psychologist seeks redemption by treating a young boy with a disturbing secret.

movie/top.name: The Truman Show
movie/top.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

movie/top.name: Children of Heaven
movie/top.description: After a boy loses his sister's pair of shoes, he goes on a series of adventures in order to find them. When he can't, he tries a new way to "win" a new pair.

movie/top.name: L.A. Confidential
movie/top.description: As corruption grows in 1950s Los Angeles, three policemen - one strait-laced, one brutal, and one sleazy - investigate a series of murders with their own brand of justice.
movie/top.descriptionAr: مع تزايد الفساد في لوس أنجلوس في خمسينيات القرن الماضي، يقوم ثلاثة من رجال الشرطة - أحدهم متشدد والآخر وحشي والآخر مهلهل - بالتحقيق في سلسلة من جرائم القتل باستخدام علامتهم التجارية الخاصة من العدالة.

movie/top.name: A Close Shave
movie/top.description: Wallace falls for Wendolene, a wool shop owner, while Gromit is framed for the sheep rustling.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يقع والاس في حب ويندولين، صاحب متجر صوف، بينما يقع جروميت في حب سرقة الأغنام.

movie/top.name: Casino
movie/top.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.
movie/top.descriptionAr: في لاس فيغاس، يتنافس أفضل صديقين - مدير كازينو وأحد منفذي المافيا - على إمبراطورية قمار وشخصية اجتماعية سريعة الحياة ومحبة.

movie/top.name: Jurassic Park
movie/top.description: An industrialist invites some experts to visit his theme park of cloned dinosaurs. After a power failure, the creatures run loose, putting everyone's lives, including his grandchildren's, in danger.

movie/top.name: Unforgiven
movie/top.description: Retired Old West gunslinger Will Munny reluctantly takes on one last job to avenge an injustice with the help of his old partner and a young would-be gunman calling himself "The Schofield Kid".

movie/top.name: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
movie/top.description: In 1938, after his father goes missing while pursuing the Holy Grail, Indiana Jones finds himself up against the Nazis again to stop them from obtaining its powers.
movie/top.descriptionAr: في عام 1938، بعد اختفاء والده أثناء ملاحقته للكأس المقدسة، يجد إنديانا جونز نفسه في مواجهة النازيين مرة أخرى لمنعهم من الحصول على صلاحياتها.

movie/top.name: Full Metal Jacket
movie/top.description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

movie/top.name: The Thing
movie/top.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

movie/top.name: A Man Called Autumn Flower
movie/top.description: During the Primo de Rivera dictatorship, young, wealthy Lluis de Serracant leads a double life: by day he's a lawyer, and by night he's a transvestite performer known to his fans as "Flower of Autumn".

movie/top.name: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
For a Few Dollars More
movie/top.description: Two bounty killers with similar intentions but different motivations team up to take down a psychotic Mexican outlaw before he and his gang can carry out an audacious bank robbery.

movie/top.name: Some Like It Hot
movie/top.description: After two male musicians witness a mob hit, they flee the state in an all-female band disguised as women, but further complications set in.

movie/top.name: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
movie/top.description: Two down-on-their-luck Americans searching for work in 1920s Mexico convince an old prospector to help them mine for gold in the Sierra Madre Mountains.

movie/top.name: Gone with the Wind
movie/top.description: A sheltered and manipulative Southern belle and a roguish profiteer face off in a turbulent romance as the society around them crumbles with the end of slavery and is rebuilt during the Civil War and Reconstruction periods.

movie/top.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movie/top.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.
movie/top.descriptionAr: يعيش "بيتر باركر" المنسي وحيدًا كرجل سبايدر مان بدوام كامل حتى يؤدي الضغط المتزايد إلى حدوث تغيير خطير وظهور عدو جديد قوي.

movie/top.name: The New Year That Never Came
Spider-Man: No Way Home
movie/top.description: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear.
movie/top.descriptionAr: بعد الكشف عن هوية Spider-Man الآن، يطلب بيتر المساعدة من دكتور Strange. عندما تسوء التعويذة، يبدأ أعداء خطرون من عوالم أخرى في الظهور.

movie/top.name: Ford v Ferrari
movie/top.description: American car designer Carroll Shelby and driver Ken Miles battle corporate interference and the laws of physics to build a revolutionary race car for Ford in order to defeat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1966.

movie/top.name: Free Solo
movie/top.description: Alex Honnold faces the biggest challenge of his career, climbing El Capitan in Yosemite National Park. He pursues it Free Solo, which means climbing without a rope and alone.

movie/top.name: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
Hacksaw Ridge
movie/top.description: World War II American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, serving during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first man in American history to receive the Medal of Honor without firing a shot.
movie/top.descriptionAr: الحرب العالمية الثانية، مسعف الجيش الأمريكي ديزموند تي دوس، الذي خدم خلال معركة أوكيناوا، يرفض قتل الناس ويصبح أول رجل في التاريخ الأمريكي يحصل على وسام الشرف دون إطلاق رصاصة واحدة.

movie/top.name: The Handmaiden
movie/top.description: In 1930s Korea, a girl is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress who lives a secluded life on a countryside estate. But the maid has a secret: She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler to help seduce the Lady and steal her ...
movie/top.descriptionAr: في كوريا في ثلاثينيات القرن العشرين، يتم تعيين فتاة كخادمة لوريثة يابانية تعيش حياة منعزلة في مزرعة ريفية. لكن الخادمة لديها سر: إنها نشالة يجندها محتال للمساعدة في إغواء السيدة وسرقتها...

movie/top.name: Spotlight
movie/top.description: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

movie/top.name: Gone Girl
movie/top.description: The husband of a missing woman becomes the main suspect in her disappearance.

movie/top.name: 12 Years a Slave
movie/top.description: In the antebellum United States, Solomon Northup, a free black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery.

movie/top.name: Rush
movie/top.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

movie/top.name: Blackfish
movie/top.description: A documentary following the controversial captivity of killer whales, and its dangers for both humans and whales.

movie/top.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
movie/top.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione set out on a quest to eliminate the remaining horcruxes. On the other hand, the students and teachers must unite to defend Hogwarts against Lord Voldemort and his army.

movie/top.name: Warrior
movie/top.description: The youngest son of an alcoholic former boxer returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament - a path that puts the fighter on a collision course with his estranged, older brother.

movie/top.name: Ratatouille
movie/top.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

movie/top.name: Million Dollar Baby
movie/top.description: Frankie, an ill-tempered old coach, reluctantly agrees to train aspiring boxer Maggie. Impressed with her determination and talent, he helps her become the best and the two soon form a close bond.

movie/top.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
movie/top.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

movie/top.name: Memories of Murder
movie/top.description: In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

movie/top.name: Catch Me If You Can
movie/top.description: Barely 17 yet, Frank is a skilled forger who has passed as a doctor, lawyer and pilot. FBI agent Carl becomes obsessed with tracking down the con man, who only revels in the pursuit.

movie/top.name: Monsters, Inc.
movie/top.description: In order to power the city, monsters have to scare children so that they scream. However, the children are toxic to the monsters, and after a child gets through, two monsters realize things may not be what they think.

movie/top.name: In the Name of the Father
Dead Poets Society
movie/top.description: Maverick teacher John Keating returns in 1959 to the prestigious New England boys' boarding school where he was once a star student, using poetry to embolden his pupils to new heights of self-expression.

movie/top.name: Platoon
movie/top.description: Chris Taylor, a neophyte recruit in Vietnam, finds himself caught in a battle of wills between two sergeants, one good and the other evil. A shrewd examination of the brutality of war and the duality of man in conflict.

movie/top.name: Raging Bull
movie/top.description: The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

movie/top.name: The Deer Hunter
movie/top.description: The lives of a group of friends are forever changed by the Vietnam War.

movie/top.name: Barry Lyndon
movie/top.description: An Irish rogue wins the heart of a rich widow and assumes her dead husband's aristocratic position in 18th-century England.

movie/top.name: The Sound of Music
movie/top.description: A young novice is sent by her convent in 1930s Austria to become a governess to the seven children of a widowed naval officer.

movie/top.name: The Bridge on the River Kwai
The Best Years of Our Lives
Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
Harry Potter 20th Anniversary: Return to Hogwarts
movie/top.description: Cast and crew members from all "Harry Potter" films reunite in a retrospective special to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone (2001).

movie/top.name: Dune: Part One
movie/top.description: Paul Atreides arrives on Arrakis after his father accepts the stewardship of the dangerous planet. However, chaos ensues after a betrayal as forces clash to control melange, a precious resource.

movie/top.name: CODA
movie/top.description: When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her musical passion and her fear of abandoning her deaf parents.

movie/top.name: Friends: The Reunion
movie/top.description: "Friends (1994)" reunion special hosted by James Corden in which the main cast revisit the sets of the original show, meet with celebrity guests, do table reads and re-enactments of episodes, and share behind-the-scenes footage.

movie/top.name: Soul
movie/top.description: Joe is a middle-school band teacher whose life hasn't quite gone the way he expected. His true passion is jazz. But when he travels to another realm to help someone find their passion, he soon discovers what it means to have soul.

movie/top.name: Zootopia
movie/top.description: In a city of anthropomorphic animals, a rookie bunny cop and a cynical con artist fox must work together to uncover a conspiracy.

movie/top.name: La La Land
movie/top.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.

movie/top.name: Going Clear: Scientology & the Prison of Belief
movie/top.description: A documentary looking at the inner-workings of the Church of Scientology.

movie/top.name: The Imitation Game
movie/top.description: During World War II, the English mathematical genius Alan Turing tries to crack the German Enigma code with help from fellow mathematicians while attempting to come to terms with his troubled private life.

movie/top.name: Her
movie/top.description: In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

movie/top.name: Citizenfour
movie/top.description: A documentarian and a reporter travel to Hong Kong for the first of many meetings with Edward Snowden.
